# 3D Reader

> Measures 3D models in the browser: real volume of material (exact for STEP/IGES/BREP), surface area, envelope (axis-aligned and minimum oriented), fill ratio, centre of mass, mass, per body. Formats: STEP, IGES, BREP, STL, OBJ, PLY, OFF, GLB/glTF, 3MF, DAE. Results in mm, mm², mm³, g.

- [Instructions for AI assistants and scripts](ai.html): open `?url=<public CORS-enabled URL of the model>&report=1`, wait for `body[data-status="done"]`, read `#reader3d-report` (text) or `#reader3d-result` (JSON); or call `await reader3d.analyze(file)` in the page; or `pip install "git+https://github.com/alexdevanssay-cmyk/3D-reader"` then `reader3d analyze FILE --json`.
- [Reader](./)

- Semantic JSON: `window.reader3d.semantic` and `#reader3d-semantic-result` (written once the page is idle after each result, `null` until then) expose feature schema 9.0, V5 manufacturing candidates and V6 `manufacturing_plan` metadata per body. V6 includes deterministic setup grouping by compatible tool axis, operation dependencies, planned order, readiness and unresolved constraints. Planning output is candidate-only and is not an executable CAM/toolpath program.

- V7 AI reasoning context: `reader3d.aiContext({ task })` returns schema `3d-ai-reasoning-context` 1.0. Supported tasks: `general`, `feature_analysis`, `manufacturing_analysis`, `dfm`, `planning`. Optional `featureIds` focuses the context. The compiler preserves feature/relation provenance, confidence, provisional status, units and unresolved constraints; it does not invent geometry or convert candidates into confirmed design intent. Manufacturing/planning outputs remain non-executable and non-CAM.
